{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts overshoot prices when sentiment is positive, especially in the early 30-day horizon",
    "Sentiment turning negative causes model to lag behind true price corrections",
    "Mean reversion bias is strongest in examples 3-5 where prices declined from earlier highs",
    "When sentiment is strongly positive (1.0), reduce forecast 3-5 points from model output",
    "Negative sentiment (below 0) requires 2-4 day lag adjustment as prices adjust slower than model predicts",
    "Prices below 65 appear to have a floor effect that model doesn't fully capture",
    "Sentiment mixed (0.3-0.7) calls for flattening forecast trajectory relative to model",
    "When history shows sharp reversal, reduce forecast magnitude by approximately 15%"
] }
